sql: WITH last_round AS (SELECT r.year,MAX(r.round) round FROM races r JOIN driver_standings ds USING(race_id) WHERE r.year>=2001 GROUP BY r.year), points AS (SELECT r.year,ds.driver_id,ds.points FROM races r JOIN last_round lr ON r.year=lr.year AND r.round=lr.round JOIN driver_standings ds USING(race_id) WHERE ds.points>0), lowest AS (SELECT * FROM points p WHERE points=(SELECT MIN(x.points) FROM points x WHERE x.year=p.year)), team_seasons AS (SELECT DISTINCT l.year,l.driver_id,l.points,re.constructor_id FROM lowest l JOIN races r ON r.year=l.year JOIN results re ON re.race_id=r.race_id AND re.driver_id=l.driver_id), counts AS (SELECT constructor_id,COUNT(DISTINCT year) seasons FROM team_seasons GROUP BY constructor_id) SELECT c.name,counts.seasons FROM counts JOIN constructors c USING(constructor_id) ORDER BY seasons DESC,c.constructor_id LIMIT 5

WITH last_round AS (SELECT r.year,MAX(r.round) round FROM races r JOIN driver_standings ds USING(race_id) WHERE r.year>=2001 GROUP BY r.year), points AS (SELECT r.year,ds.driver_id,ds.points FROM races r JOIN last_round lr ON r.year=lr.year AND r.round=lr.round JOIN driver_standings ds USING(race_id) WHERE ds.points>0), lowest AS (SELECT * FROM points p WHERE points=(SELECT MIN(x.points) FROM points x WHERE x.year=p.year)), team_seasons AS (SELECT DISTINCT l.year,l.driver_id,l.points,re.constructor_id FROM lowest l JOIN races r ON r.year=l.year JOIN results re ON re.race_id=r.race_id AND re.driver_id=l.driver_id), counts AS (SELECT constructor_id,COUNT(DISTINCT year) seasons FROM team_seasons GROUP BY constructor_id) SELECT t.year,d.forename,d.surname,t.points,c.name FROM team_seasons t JOIN drivers d USING(driver_id) JOIN constructors c USING(constructor_id) ORDER BY year,t.driver_id,c.constructor_id

WITH last_round AS (SELECT r.year,MAX(r.round) round FROM races r JOIN driver_standings ds USING(race_id) WHERE r.year>=2001 GROUP BY r.year), points AS (SELECT r.year,ds.driver_id,ds.points FROM races r JOIN last_round lr ON r.year=lr.year AND r.round=lr.round JOIN driver_standings ds USING(race_id) WHERE ds.points>0), lowest AS (SELECT * FROM points p WHERE points=(SELECT MIN(x.points) FROM points x WHERE x.year=p.year)), team_seasons AS (SELECT DISTINCT l.year,l.driver_id,l.points,re.constructor_id FROM lowest l JOIN races r ON r.year=l.year JOIN results re ON re.race_id=r.race_id AND re.driver_id=l.driver_id), counts AS (SELECT constructor_id,COUNT(DISTINCT year) seasons FROM team_seasons GROUP BY constructor_id) SELECT c.constructor_id,c.name,seasons FROM counts JOIN constructors c USING(constructor_id) ORDER BY seasons DESC,c.constructor_id

WITH ev AS (SELECT r.year,re.driver_id,re.points FROM results re JOIN races r USING(race_id) WHERE year>=2001 UNION ALL SELECT r.year,s.driver_id,s.points FROM sprint_results s JOIN races r USING(race_id) WHERE year>=2001), totals AS (SELECT year,driver_id,SUM(points) points FROM ev GROUP BY year,driver_id), lr AS (SELECT r.year,MAX(round) round FROM races r JOIN driver_standings ds USING(race_id) WHERE year>=2001 GROUP BY year) SELECT r.year,d.forename,d.surname,ds.points standings,t.points result_and_sprint FROM driver_standings ds JOIN races r USING(race_id) JOIN lr ON lr.year=r.year AND lr.round=r.round JOIN totals t ON t.year=r.year AND t.driver_id=ds.driver_id JOIN drivers d USING(driver_id) WHERE ABS(ds.points-t.points)>0.00001 ORDER BY r.year,ds.driver_id

SELECT r.year,MAX(r.round) calendar_last,MAX(CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM results re WHERE re.race_id=r.race_id) THEN r.round END) results_last,MAX(CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM driver_standings d WHERE d.race_id=r.race_id) THEN r.round END) standings_last,COUNT(*) races FROM races r WHERE year>=2001 GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

WITH last_round AS (SELECT r.year,MAX(r.round) round FROM races r JOIN driver_standings ds USING(race_id) WHERE r.year>=2001 GROUP BY r.year), points AS (SELECT r.year,ds.driver_id,ds.points FROM races r JOIN last_round lr ON r.year=lr.year AND r.round=lr.round JOIN driver_standings ds USING(race_id) WHERE ds.points>0), lowest AS (SELECT * FROM points p WHERE points=(SELECT MIN(x.points) FROM points x WHERE x.year=p.year)), team_seasons AS (SELECT DISTINCT l.year,l.driver_id,l.points,re.constructor_id FROM lowest l JOIN races r ON r.year=l.year JOIN results re ON re.race_id=r.race_id AND re.driver_id=l.driver_id), counts AS (SELECT constructor_id,COUNT(DISTINCT year) seasons FROM team_seasons GROUP BY constructor_id) SELECT c.name,counts.seasons FROM counts JOIN constructors c USING(constructor_id) ORDER BY seasons DESC,c.constructor_id LIMIT 5

WITH lr AS (SELECT r.year,MAX(round) round FROM races r JOIN driver_standings ds USING(race_id) WHERE year>=2001 GROUP BY year), seasons_points AS (
 SELECT 'final_standings' method,r.year,ds.driver_id,ds.points FROM driver_standings ds JOIN races r USING(race_id) JOIN lr ON lr.year=r.year AND lr.round=r.round
 UNION ALL SELECT 'sum_cumulative_standings',r.year,ds.driver_id,SUM(ds.points) FROM driver_standings ds JOIN races r USING(race_id) WHERE year>=2001 GROUP BY r.year,ds.driver_id
 UNION ALL SELECT 'race_only',r.year,re.driver_id,SUM(re.points) FROM results re JOIN races r USING(race_id) WHERE year>=2001 GROUP BY r.year,re.driver_id
 UNION ALL SELECT 'positive_race_min',r.year,re.driver_id,MIN(re.points) FROM results re JOIN races r USING(race_id) WHERE year>=2001 AND re.points>0 GROUP BY r.year,re.driver_id
), low AS (SELECT * FROM seasons_points p WHERE points>0 AND points=(SELECT MIN(x.points) FROM seasons_points x WHERE x.year=p.year AND x.method=p.method AND points>0)), ct AS (SELECT l.method,l.year,re.constructor_id,l.driver_id FROM low l JOIN races r ON r.year=l.year JOIN results re ON re.race_id=r.race_id AND re.driver_id=l.driver_id), counts AS (SELECT method,constructor_id,COUNT(DISTINCT year) seasons FROM ct GROUP BY method,constructor_id), ranked AS (SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY method ORDER BY seasons DESC,constructor_id) rn FROM counts) SELECT method,c.name,seasons,rn FROM ranked JOIN constructors c USING(constructor_id) WHERE rn<=8 ORDER BY method,rn

WITH last_round AS (SELECT r.year,MAX(r.round) round FROM races r JOIN driver_standings ds USING(race_id) WHERE r.year>=2001 GROUP BY r.year), points AS (SELECT r.year,ds.driver_id,ds.points FROM races r JOIN last_round lr ON r.year=lr.year AND r.round=lr.round JOIN driver_standings ds USING(race_id) WHERE ds.points>0), lowest AS (SELECT * FROM points p WHERE points=(SELECT MIN(x.points) FROM points x WHERE x.year=p.year)), team_seasons AS (SELECT DISTINCT l.year,l.driver_id,l.points,re.constructor_id FROM lowest l JOIN races r ON r.year=l.year JOIN results re ON re.race_id=r.race_id AND re.driver_id=l.driver_id), counts AS (SELECT constructor_id,COUNT(DISTINCT year) seasons FROM team_seasons GROUP BY constructor_id) , career AS (SELECT DISTINCT l.year,l.driver_id,re.constructor_id FROM lowest l JOIN results re USING(driver_id)), latest AS (SELECT ts.* FROM team_seasons ts WHERE ts.constructor_id=(SELECT re.constructor_id FROM results re JOIN races r USING(race_id) WHERE r.year=ts.year AND re.driver_id=ts.driver_id ORDER BY r.round DESC LIMIT 1)), scoring AS (SELECT DISTINCT l.year,l.driver_id,re.constructor_id FROM lowest l JOIN results re USING(driver_id) JOIN races r ON r.race_id=re.race_id AND r.year=l.year WHERE re.points>0), variants AS (SELECT 'career' method,year,driver_id,constructor_id FROM career UNION ALL SELECT 'latest_team',year,driver_id,constructor_id FROM latest UNION ALL SELECT 'scoring_team',year,driver_id,constructor_id FROM scoring UNION ALL SELECT 'same_year_driver_count',year,driver_id,constructor_id FROM (SELECT DISTINCT year,driver_id,constructor_id FROM team_seasons)), sums AS (SELECT method,constructor_id,CASE WHEN method='same_year_driver_count' THEN COUNT(*) ELSE COUNT(DISTINCT year) END n FROM variants GROUP BY method,constructor_id), ranked AS (SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY method ORDER BY n DESC,constructor_id) rn FROM sums) SELECT method,c.name,n,rn FROM ranked JOIN constructors c USING(constructor_id) WHERE rn<=8 ORDER BY method,rn

WITH last_round AS (SELECT r.year,MAX(r.round) round FROM races r JOIN driver_standings ds USING(race_id) WHERE r.year>=2001 GROUP BY r.year), points AS (SELECT r.year,ds.driver_id,ds.points FROM races r JOIN last_round lr ON r.year=lr.year AND r.round=lr.round JOIN driver_standings ds USING(race_id) WHERE ds.points>0), lowest AS (SELECT * FROM points p WHERE points=(SELECT MIN(x.points) FROM points x WHERE x.year=p.year)), team_seasons AS (SELECT DISTINCT l.year,l.driver_id,l.points,re.constructor_id FROM lowest l JOIN races r ON r.year=l.year JOIN results re ON re.race_id=r.race_id AND re.driver_id=l.driver_id), counts AS (SELECT constructor_id,COUNT(DISTINCT year) seasons FROM team_seasons GROUP BY constructor_id) , scoring AS (SELECT DISTINCT l.year,l.driver_id,re.constructor_id FROM lowest l JOIN results re USING(driver_id) JOIN races r ON r.race_id=re.race_id AND r.year=l.year WHERE re.points>0), sc AS (SELECT constructor_id,COUNT(DISTINCT year) n FROM scoring GROUP BY constructor_id) SELECT c.name,n FROM sc JOIN constructors c USING(constructor_id) ORDER BY n DESC,c.name ASC LIMIT 5

WITH totals AS (SELECT r.year,re.driver_id,re.constructor_id,SUM(re.points) points FROM results re JOIN races r USING(race_id) WHERE year>=2001 GROUP BY r.year,re.driver_id,re.constructor_id HAVING SUM(re.points)>0), low AS (SELECT * FROM totals t WHERE points=(SELECT MIN(points) FROM totals x WHERE x.year=t.year)), ct AS (SELECT constructor_id,COUNT(DISTINCT year) n FROM low GROUP BY constructor_id) SELECT c.name,n FROM ct JOIN constructors c USING(constructor_id) ORDER BY n DESC,c.name LIMIT 8

WITH last_round AS (SELECT r.year,MAX(r.round) round FROM races r JOIN driver_standings ds USING(race_id) WHERE r.year>=2001 GROUP BY r.year), points AS (SELECT r.year,ds.driver_id,ds.points FROM races r JOIN last_round lr ON r.year=lr.year AND r.round=lr.round JOIN driver_standings ds USING(race_id) WHERE ds.points>0), lowest AS (SELECT * FROM points p WHERE points=(SELECT MIN(x.points) FROM points x WHERE x.year=p.year)), team_seasons AS (SELECT DISTINCT l.year,l.driver_id,l.points,re.constructor_id FROM lowest l JOIN races r ON r.year=l.year JOIN results re ON re.race_id=r.race_id AND re.driver_id=l.driver_id), counts AS (SELECT constructor_id,COUNT(DISTINCT year) seasons FROM team_seasons GROUP BY constructor_id) SELECT ts.year,d.forename,d.surname,c.name,ts.points,SUM(re.points) points_with_team FROM team_seasons ts JOIN drivers d USING(driver_id) JOIN constructors c USING(constructor_id) JOIN races r ON r.year=ts.year JOIN results re ON re.race_id=r.race_id AND re.driver_id=ts.driver_id AND re.constructor_id=ts.constructor_id GROUP BY ts.year,ts.driver_id,ts.constructor_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ts.constructor_id)=1 AND SUM(re.points)=0 ORDER BY ts.year

WITH totals AS (SELECT r.year,re.driver_id,re.constructor_id,SUM(re.points) points FROM results re JOIN races r USING(race_id) WHERE year>=2001 GROUP BY r.year,re.driver_id,re.constructor_id HAVING SUM(re.points)>0), low AS (SELECT * FROM totals t WHERE points=(SELECT MIN(points) FROM totals x WHERE x.year=t.year)) SELECT l.year,d.forename,d.surname,c.name,l.points FROM low l JOIN drivers d USING(driver_id) JOIN constructors c USING(constructor_id) WHERE constructor_id IN (15,17,18,21) ORDER BY year,constructor_id
